notes.title: Demo Game Loop Complete
notes.notes: It's been a long time coming. The Soul Recursion demo game loop is complete. The first round of testing is now. We are looking for beta/Alpha testers now. We have a few already and are running the first ever alpha tests. Stay in the loop and become an alpha tester.
